description: The pie chart titled “w/o Reference Answer and Test Case” depicts the distribution of items across three categories, shown as three slices. The slices are labeled with both counts (in the legend) and percentages (next to the slices): “Null” is colored pink/red and represents about 39.2% (549,238), “Have reference answer” is colored blue and represents about 38.9% (543,935), and “Have test case” is colored light green and represents about 21.9% (306,818). A legend in the upper-left lists the three categories with their counts, and percentage labels are displayed outside the corresponding slices; no slice appears exploded or otherwise visually emphasized, and the slice arrangement does not appear explicitly ordered by size.
